answer: Entry requires a sponsor bond: an established identity stakes 78 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must therefore buy 6 sponsors per fake or post the bond itself, turning every alias into a 78-POA liability instead of a free account. The karst is the check that cannot be faked, the kernel is the price the attacker pays, and the copper is the record that outlives the epoch.
